seo.title: Pip — Atlanta Train Times with a Little Peach of a Train
seo.description: Atlanta train times for iPhone and Apple Watch with a friend in it. Pip, a little peach of a train, tells you the moment to leave for the next train you can make: your walk built in, the change spelled out, a step-by-step guide on your Lock Screen, widgets and Siri. Free, no account, no tracking.

hero.label: TRAIN TIMES
hero.title: Know when to leave for your train.
text: Meet Pip, a little peach of a train who waits on the platform with you and tells you the moment to leave.
